grain: account_id x limit_scope_id x distinct source observation

semantics.poll_time: recorder/poll wall-clock time; does not refresh source evidence
semantics.source_observed_at: local proxy wall clock captured when response-header metadata is applied; not provider event time
semantics.source_clock_type: must explicitly identify local proxy clock semantics; provider clock must not be invented
semantics.duplicate_sample: producer stale=true means unchanged source timestamp. A duplicate may remain within an explicit age policy but is not independent evidence
semantics.missing_duplicate_sample: not fresh by itself; may be interpreted only with pinned producer/version plus source timestamp identity semantics
semantics.reset_epoch: recorded schedule metadata; passage is neither restoration nor available-capacity proof
semantics.utilization_fraction: scope-local observed fraction only, contract domain [0,1]; never a certified cumulative debit and never additive across scopes/accounts
semantics.derived_display_projection: post-reset projected zero or other display transformation is not a measured utilization/debit fact
semantics.restoration_attestation: separate source-owned evidence required for post-reset restoration claims
semantics.quantization: source resolution metadata; never fabricate precision below it
semantics.clock_skew_bound_seconds: declared timing uncertainty for local clocks

trust_boundary: source-owned attestations and producer/version identity must be authenticated upstream; offline evaluator does not authenticate them
non_failure_by_itself: duplicate_sample=true while observation remains within explicit age policy before reset
